notes: One trigger_teleport out of 62 is aimed at the destination named `end`, and it is a 71x43 gate rather than one of the room-sized pits the other 61 are -- so it is a thing a player walks through on purpose, which is what a finish is. There is no matching start label: the map's 24 info_player_* spawns sit in a tight 291x755 cluster at [4318 1146 6852] and that cluster is the start platform, so the start line is drawn around it rather than around a name.
